keywords: the loveliest rose in the world
full_text:
A noble queen was dying of a mysterious sorrow. The wise men announced: "She can be saved only if she gazes upon the Loveliest Rose in the World—the rose that expresses the highest and purest love!"

They brought roses of chivalry, roses of patriotic sacrifice, and roses of bridal devotion; but the queen grew paler still.

Then came a little child holding a holy book, reading the story of Him who gave His life on the cross to save mankind.

A flush of radiant life returned to the queen's cheeks, and she smiled with heavenly joy: "I see it! The rose that blooms from divine love and sacrifice is the Loveliest Rose in the World, and whoever beholds it shall never die!"
moral: The loveliest rose in the world is the radiant blossom of unselfish love and sacrifice.
